assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The patient has a diagnosis of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The procedure is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes.
The diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to evaluate recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the context of the patient's cardiac and cerebrovascular history.
